fields.statement: Verified at ec2d8a5bf (attempt 2). go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run ShipMergeRefused (and -run ShipMerge) pass: TestShipMergeRefusedStops, with a fake gh pr merge failing 'the base branch policy prohibits the merge' (bare, and as gh's full messages 'X Pull request owner/repo#7 is not mergeable: the base branch policy prohibits the merge.' with and without the X), asserts ship merge exits 75 with a stop naming that reason and records no merge commit; gh's full 'not up to date' and 'cannot be cleanly created' messages, plus behind/conflict variants, still fail (exit 1, to gate-rebase-merge). go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow -run ShipChange passes: TestShipChangeMergeRefusedStops checks merge's on.fail is gate-rebase-merge and on.pass wait-main, and go test ./internal/run -run StopExitStopsRun passes, showing an exit-75 command stops the run without taking on.fail, so a refused merge never visits gate-rebase-merge. Diff read: the attempt-1 finding is fixed ('not mergeable' dropped from shipMergeCurable, which now matches only the reason after gh's prefix); execIn passes gh's stderr into the error text, so the real message reaches shipMergeRefusal; describe-golden and cli.md updated for the stop field.
